method: Actual app/ballot/page.tsx, normal readerRoute and readerBallotSourcesForDivisions, ordinary proof attestation from MemoryRoutineDataStore seeded with the exact SELECT-only production replay. Existing edgeOnly context refuses database fallbacks. Actual server components resolve, then react-dom/server renders the real synchronous/client components.

place.basis: The live Google Civic normalized address and TurboVote sample both establish94118. This page proof uses the real94118 ZIP reader; it does not claim a new exact-address geocode.

initialHarnessFailures.cause: The first replay supplied only the generic promoted map; the actual state reader requires the existing stateAuthorities.load interface. The harness now supplies that ordinary interface.

initialHarnessFailures.cause: The harness used an incorrect BOE contest ID. Corrected to the actual persisted ID including member.

limitations: Auxiliary authorities not loaded into this replay remain unavailable and show the app existing gap behavior. This is a real-data read-only local rendering proof, not evidence that production has published these changes.

browser.method: Actual rendered app page SSR HTML, with the currently built app CSS. Served by Playwright route fulfillment from memory at a loopback URL; no database or server mutation. Client hydration and out-of-replay auxiliary authorities are not included.
